Name: ProceduralNoise
Label: Procedural noise
Description: Builds a reusable mask from the shared procedural noise catalog.

Params.Name: Frequency
Params.Description: Sampling frequency of the procedural breakup.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values create smaller, more frequent patches.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Description: Deterministically changes the procedural noise pattern.
Params.Tooltip: Use a new seed for a different breakup layout without changing its frequency.

Params.Name: NoiseOctaves
Params.Description: Controls how many frequency layers are combined.
Params.Tooltip: More octaves add detail at a higher shader cost.

Params.Name: Lacunarity
Params.Description: Controls the frequency multiplier between layers.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values separate the detail scales more strongly.

Params.Name: Persistence
Params.Description: Controls how much amplitude each layer retains.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values keep more fine detail visible.
